dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed 'O' and open 'C' structures exhibit a sharp transition from high-intensity white perimeters to low-intensity dark centers. The edges are irregularly serrated at a pixel level, particularly in the largest structure located in the upper-mid region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of solid, high-intensity pixel clusters is concentrated on the far-left anterior region. Lower density, isolated low-intensity blobs are scattered along the transition boundary between the patterned and solid regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form a scalene triangle. A secondary chain of five smaller ring centroids creates a curvilinear path following the upper anterior-lateral boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: The primary topological feature is a continuous, interlocking reticulated network where high-contrast edges often serve as shared boundaries between adjacent polygonal cells.
